scope: authenticated A4 method-level training runs only; validation, held-out, and critical method outputs were not read
selection_rule: minimize reciprocal false-merge proxy rate and count
minimize nonreciprocal false-break proxy and unavailable rows
larger ambiguity margin, shorter maximum gap, larger separation

completion_sentinel.launcher_drift_reason: Only the completion-footer schema and post-validation fields changed during execution; scientific runner, frozen scales, grid, and run commands did not drift.

limitations: Only 15 confirmed-female training annotations are available.
Female-only annotations cannot expose male-to-male swaps.
False-merge and false-break counts are motion/reciprocity proxies, not labeled biological errors.
Lower residual and smoother paths are quality checks, not identity proof.
Temporal controls are length-matched, not behavior- or risk-matched.
